items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: We're very close friends. ... What can you tell me about Oliver Alcorn? Well, we raised up together.

ctx.x: Piano player, yeah. Ed Garland on the bass, Minor Hall on the drums, Ory, and myself. I played up there with them for a long time. And then I left that and I went with Les Hyde, a big band.

items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: I played with Joe a long time, around here.

ctx.x: And Dink. Yeah, Dink. Dink Johnson. Yeah. You know Dink? Yeah. He was a great piano player and great drummer and…
He played drums when he first came here. I think he came here in Joe Oliver's band.
